exclusions.reason: Organisation/title and informal support are provenance or evaluation; necessary impulse, sensible bundling and hoped-for broad digitisation are policy judgements or goals. The concrete mandate/history/first-legal-backing and ordinary-channel premises are separately assessed.

Long-term caps, regulation and predictability are recommendations. Threatened cumulative financial strain as more services are digitised is a conditional future concern without a specified amount/cohort, not a realised cost claim or a contradiction. The draft cost-allocation and programme descriptions are separately assessed.

Extending funding until complete connection, training/roll-in teams, usage targets/KPIs, feedback/star metrics and continuous improvement are design requests. VITAKO’s own proposed KPI suitability is evaluative/self-description, with no quantified causal effectiveness claimed. Do not turn these into error or unresolved quotas. Actual prior programme contribution and availability-versus-use mechanism are assessed separately.

Very ambitious is evaluation; prompt notice, adequate lead time and the proposed twelve-month new § 1(2) are recommendations/forecasts. The stated target, draft commencement and absence of explicit ordinance enforcement are separately inventoried.

limitations: All two original pages read and visually inspected before old targeted dispositions or any IT counterpart inventory. No new error candidate proposed.
Author date is unverified. Current-source chronology and identified draft scope are explicit; no delivery inference from publication.
Long background material was limited to necessary provisions or selected passages; read extents are recorded.
No author contact or human specialist confirmation. Missing evidence, undefined broad first-ever wording and pure forecasts do not become errors.
